name: unity-finance-firebase-functions
description: Cloud Functions for the Unity Finance Firebase provider. Parallel to backend/functions (Appwrite), which is untouched and keeps running.
//scripts: `test`      — Node's built-in runner. No emulator, no network. 77 pass, 17 skip.
`test:all`  — the SAME suite under the Firestore emulator. 94 pass, 0 skip.
The rules tests SKIP unless @firebase/rules-unit-testing is installed AND the
emulator is running; they never silently pass. Use `test:all` for the full run.
The emulator needs a JDK. If `java` is not on PATH, Android Studio ships one:
NOTE: every value under `scripts` must be a STRING. An array there is accepted
by `npm test` but makes `npm pkg set` fail with ESCRIPTSINVALID, which is why
this note lives at the top level instead.
